\section*{Multiple Choice (10 marks)}
\begin{enumerate}[label=\arabic*.]
\item Cholesterol and fatty acids absorbed from the intestinal lumen are packaged into which
types of lipoproteins and secreted from the enterocytes into the lymph?
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Chylomicrons only
    \item LDL only
    \item VLDL and LDL
    \item Chylomicrons and HDL
    \item VLDL and HDL
\end{enumerate}
\item A burial site where the body is allowed to decompose naturally without a casket is called
a \_\_\_\_\_ cemetery
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Eco-friendly
    \item Sunshine
    \item Forest
    \item Rapid decay
    \item Organic
\end{enumerate}
\item Older adults are able to improve their memories and reduce their anxiety about declining
memory when
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item They engage in social activities and interact with peers
    \item They practice mindfulness and meditation to reduce stress levels
    \item They engage in physical activity regularly
    \item They regularly solve puzzles and engage in brain-stimulating activities
    \item They learn that many aspects of memory do not decline and some even get better
\end{enumerate}
\item The energy charge of the cell is:
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item the extent to which the total adenine nucleotide pool is phosphorylated.
    \item the difference between the total energy input and output of the cell.
    \item generated by the sodium-potassium ATPase.
    \item the amount of ATP available in the cell.
    \item the energy required for the maintenance of the cell's structure.
\end{enumerate}
\item The following amino acids are all essential components of the diet:
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item leucine, methionine and threonine
    \item leucine, cysteine and glycine
    \item proline, tyrosine and serine
    \item valine, glycine and arginine
    \item methionine, serine and tyrosine
\end{enumerate}
\end{enumerate}

\section*{True / False (10 marks)}
\textit{Answer True or False}
\begin{enumerate}[label=\arabic*.]
\setcounter{enumi}{5}
\item True or False: Nearly one-third of grieving individuals appear to require some form of professional help during their mourning process.
\item True or False: A person weighing 62 kg with a drug dose of 15 mg/kg requires a total dose of 18.6 grams.
\item True or False: Type IIb muscle fibers are characterized by low fatigue resistance compared to other muscle fiber types.
\item True or False: Meat and dairy products are consumed in lower quantities in Wales and Scotland compared to fruits and vegetables.
\item True or False: A normal resting heart rate for an adult is considered to be between 70 and 90 beats per minute.
\end{enumerate}

\textit{Answer each question with a clear and complete explanation.}
